artifacts.description: Original official-source URL/version/access/digest receipts, small excerpts, original setup stdout, source hashes and static preview inspection.
Fresh GitHub provider release metadata via GitHub.fetch, with asset names/bytes/digests and original HTTP response receipt.
Reviewer authored whole-file line coverage, English/Chinese correspondence, direct derivations and prerequisite figure visual receipt.
Exact reviewer verification program used for successful evidence generation; no model/torch import.

factual_accuracy.details: The complete frozen English file and necessary Chinese counterpart were read. All forty atomic claims were checked against original source, provider documentation, and original measurement data. No factual contradiction was found.

numeric_verification.details: Recounted 331 plus 26 sections, the eighteen new lessons, and all v2 archive files and records. Recomputed AV 200/200, waveform-swap 148/200, Choice 39/60, acceptance 53 with 19 errors, and every condition for the 200 sound programs. Historical values matched original receipts with the correct loop and sample scope.

figure_consistency.details: The English whole file contains no image and its freeze requires an empty figure map. The Chinese prerequisite diagram was rendered and viewed separately; its character-to-ID mapping matched the source. The render remains outside Git.

source_verification.details: Read original PyTorch 2.14 API contracts, official uv, Git, LFS, and IPython documentation, pinned Kev source, repository implementations, raw stdout, preserved final rows, and fresh provider metadata. Full third-party texts remain outside Git; portable reviewer evidence contains small excerpts and digests.

limitations.details: Preserved finite task and data limits, the C promotion failure and waveform diagnosis, legacy failed criteria, the distinction between dry runs and learning, inference and exact resumption, single examples and accuracy, and CPU and other platforms. No formal model forward, training, retuning, Modal job, workflow, or publication was performed.

verification_limits: desktop/mobile full-page layout and interactive site behavior
new or historical NN inference/training reruns
statistical generalization beyond the frozen finite tests
fresh download of every120historical weightfile; source manifests and preservedoriginalCPUreceipts inspected
independence_statement: Only assigned frozen English unit, explicitly necessary canonical Chinese counterpart, neutral source packet, primary sources, source code and original measurement/command data read. No other reviewer verdict, issues, reader answers or author disposition was read before this original.
format_validation: Validated separately with the existing checker. The checker does not establish technical truth or collection and seal status.
format_revision_note: The immutable original verdict and evidence are retained. This current version improves prose spacing and readability only; it changes no source, numerical result, claim status, or verdict.
